summary: Practise crisis briefings, message mapping, and media interviews using realistic scenarios. Explore the five-day crisis spokesperson course.
lede: Crisis spokesperson training helps communication professionals and operational leaders give verified updates as incidents develop. Participants practise distinguishing confirmed facts from assumptions, coordinating with incident leadership, and using message maps to prepare holding statements, interview responses, and corrections. Timed briefings and scenario exercises also build skills in Q&A preparation and maintaining consistent updates across media and digital channels.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who speak for organizations during incidents, coordinate crisis communications, or prepare leaders for media scrutiny. It suits intermediate learners who work with response teams and need a structured approach to verified, consistent public statements.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with organizational communications, media relations, or incident response is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop if you want to edit digital planning artefacts; no specific software installation is required.
